shortDescription: Get metadata for specific zones in UltraDNS

options.name: fail_on_error
options.description: If true, the module will fail if any zone metadata cannot be retrieved. If false, zones that cause errors (like non-existent zones) will be skipped and noted in the return message. Common error is code 1801 "Zone does not exist in the system" for non-existent zones.

options.name: zones
options.description: List of zone names for which to retrieve metadata. Each zone name will be used in an individual API call.
